task.title: Finally verify real session persistence and revocation across paths
task.input: Device/API/UI capabilities, the locked Auth.js version and section 17 real-session checks
task.output: session-acceptance: initial login/activity refresh/SSR/sign-out and browser-reopen evidence
task.accept: 1) Log in for real and verify the activity-sliding two-hour policy for rememberDevice=false. Actual POST /api/admin/account/session/activity writes a renewed Set-Cookie; read-only SSR never claims renewal. HTTP boundary tests reject equality/expiry at seven idle days and the 30-day absolute limit for remembered devices; continuous activity cannot exceed 30 days (E-01, E-02, E-69, E-71). 2) An unexpired remembered cookie restores access after closing/reopening the same browser. After actual password change, authenticator reset, logout-all, device revocation, account disablement or sv change, the next real protected request rejects the old cookie and refresh cannot revive it. Ordinary Auth.js signOut revokes sid; unavailable database checks deny access. Invalid mode, unenabled totp and nonempty ordinary recoveryCode yield generic login failure (E-03, E-04, E-70, E-96).
